text:
Keira (Design): quick design review: compact density + presets for model compare. users keep scrolling too much when comparing 8+ models.
Ravi (Eng): backend needs a pref endpoint to persist density and column order. small change but mindful of migration.
Maya (PM): primary goals: reduce vertical scroll, make presets shareable, and avoid hiding critical metadata. metrics: compare completion rate, average time per compare.
Owen (Research): in tests people wanted badges visible but shortened. propose legend for compact view. they liked a simple toggle but wanted it to stick for the session.
Ava (A11y): compact mode must preserve semantics: aria-label full text on badges, focus targets >=44px. if we abbreviate, put full text in accessible label and tooltip.
Keira (Design): proposed UI: header toggle "Compact" + a small "legend" icon that opens a panel. compact rows: reduce vertical padding, hide secondary tags, abbreviate badge text to 2-3 chars.
Ravi (Eng): implement with CSS modifier .row--compact and .badge--compact. ellipsize long model names, keep title as accessible text.
Maya (PM): presets: allow users to save filter sets and share with team. need name + scope (personal/team).
Ravi (Eng): server: POST /api/presets, GET /api/presets?team=true. also return preset_valid flag for server-side validation if models/versions were removed.
Owen (Research): add a small onboarding tooltip when compact first appears explaining legend and how to revert.
Ava (A11y): legend should be a dialog with role="dialog", focus trap, and accessible list of abbreviations. announce on open.
Keira (Design): copy for legend: "L: latency — ok/slow; C: cost — low/med/high; Q: quantization — int8/float16." full tooltip text remains on hover.
Maya (PM): rollout plan: feature flag for 20% then ramp. events: compact_toggled, preset_saved, preset_applied, preset_invalid.
Ravi (Eng): estimate: 4 dev days + 1 QA day. will prototype in feature branch.
Keira (Design): I'll upload mocks with compact tokens and legend artboard by tomorrow noon.
staging-bot: staging preview up at https://staging.redwood.company/review/4042 behind flag 'catalog_compact'.
Maya (PM): great. last nits: tooltip delay 250ms, focus ring visible on compact chips, ensure keyboard can save/apply presets.
Ravi (Eng): will include keyboard flows and a11y labels in PR.
Ava (A11y): I'll run quick axe pass on the preview and share results.
Keira (Design): thanks team — will annotate mocks with accessibility notes and share link here.
Maya (PM): awesome, aiming for staged rollout next month.
